sentences.en: You probably want to change your life.
sentences.zh: 你大概想改变自己的人生。

sentences.en: That's probably why you clicked on this video.
sentences.zh: 这大概也是你点开这个视频的原因。

sentences.en: But for some reason, you just can't do it.
sentences.zh: 但不知为什么，你就是做不到。

sentences.en: You're tired of your physique or how your mind has not been your friend lately or how you have to stress over not being able to pay the bills each month or how you're going to end up alone or just whatever it is.
sentences.zh: 你受够了现在的身材，受够了最近脑子总跟你作对，受够了每个月为付不起账单而焦虑，受够了担心自己会孤独终老，或者不管是什么让你烦心的事。

sentences.en: And so you finally gain the motivation to start going to the gym or to start the business or to start talking to more people.
sentences.zh: 于是你终于攒够了动力，开始去健身房，开始创业，开始跟更多人交流。

sentences.en: You know, the drill.
sentences.zh: 你懂的，老一套。

sentences.en: You just get motivated.
sentences.zh: 你就是来了动力。

sentences.en: And then you fast forward two to four weeks and you find yourself in the exact same position that you were in before.
sentences.zh: 然后快进两到四周，你发现自己又回到了跟之前一模一样的位置。

sentences.en: And you don't even know how it happened.
sentences.zh: 你甚至都不知道是怎么发生的。

sentences.en: You just ended up back in your old life and it looks the exact same.
sentences.zh: 你就是又回到了旧生活里，看起来毫无变化。

sentences.en: You're not going to the gym anymore.
sentences.zh: 你不再去健身房了。

sentences.en: You stopped working on the business.
sentences.zh: 你停下了创业的事。

sentences.en: You just went back to your old habits.
sentences.zh: 你只是回到了旧习惯里。

sentences.en: And this probably isn't the first time you lock in.
sentences.zh: 这大概也不是你第一次"锁死"自己。

sentences.en: Then you fall off.
sentences.zh: 然后你又崩了。

sentences.en: Then you lock in again.
sentences.zh: 然后你又"锁死"。

sentences.en: Then you fall off and 10 years go by for some people their entire lives go by without breaking the habit of being your worst self.
sentences.zh: 然后又崩了，十年就这么过去了。对有些人来说，一辈子就这么过去了，始终没能打破"做最差版本的自己"这个习惯。

sentences.en: It sucks.
sentences.zh: 这感觉糟透了。

sentences.en: It's like you never even tried to change because well, frankly, you didn't. You didn't actually try.
sentences.zh: 就好像你从未真正尝试过改变，因为，说实话，你就是没有。你没有真正去试。

sentences.en: So what do you do?
sentences.zh: 那你该怎么办？

sentences.en: Well, if you look at the top athletes or startup founders, visionaries and strategists who seem to work 16 hours a day without breaking a sweat, do you think that they struggle to do that or is that what they want to do?
sentences.zh: 你看看那些顶尖运动员、初创公司创始人、愿景家和战略家，他们似乎一天工作 16 小时都毫不费力。你觉得他们是苦苦挣扎才做到的吗？还是说，那本来就是他们想做的事？

sentences.en: Is it actually hard for a successful person to go to bed at the right time to eat the right foods, to go to the gym every day, to work on their business like it's a normal thing to do?
sentences.zh: 对一个成功的人来说，在正确的时间上床睡觉、吃正确的食物、每天去健身房、经营自己的事业，真的很难吗？就像做一件再正常不过的事？

sentences.en: No, it's not hard for them at all.
sentences.zh: 不，对他们来说一点都不难。

sentences.en: It's actually extremely hard for them to do what the average person does.
sentences.zh: 实际上，让他们去做普通人做的事，才是极其困难的。

sentences.en: It's honestly a living hell for them to sense that they're devolving into a mediocre life.
sentences.zh: 说实话，感觉到自己正在滑向平庸的人生，对他们来说就是活生生的地狱。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because that's who they are.
sentences.zh: 因为那就是他们是谁。

sentences.en: So how do we replicate this in our own life?
sentences.zh: 那我们怎么在自己的生活中复制这一点？

sentences.en: How do we become someone?
sentences.zh: 我们怎么成为"某个人"？

sentences.en: We're doing the things we want to do to achieve our version of success is just as normal to us as brushing our teeth.
sentences.zh: 我们做着那些想做的事，去实现属于我们自己的成功版本，这件事对我们来说就像刷牙一样自然。

sentences.en: If you brush your teeth.
sentences.zh: 如果你刷牙的话。

sentences.en: Well, what you have to do is you have to become so disgusted with where you are that you have no option but to win.
sentences.zh: 你要做的，就是对自己当下的处境感到如此恶心，以至于你别无选择，只能赢。

sentences.en: Now, I've talked about this many times before, but I recently watched a video from Kahl-Ram, and he had this incredible analogy, and it's that rockets use 85% to 90% of their total mass as fuel during launch and acceleration.
sentences.zh: 我之前聊过很多次这个观点，但我最近看了 Kahl-Ram 的一个视频，他打了一个特别棒的比方：火箭在发射和加速阶段，会消耗掉自身总质量的 85% 到 90% 作为燃料。

sentences.en: Whereas coasting requires zero fuel once orbital or escape velocity is reached.
sentences.zh: 而一旦达到轨道速度或逃逸速度，滑行阶段就完全不需要燃料了。

sentences.en: So in other words, what gets you started isn't what keeps you going.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，让你起步的东西，并不是让你持续下去的东西。

sentences.en: And in other other words, you need a very potent source of fuel.
sentences.zh: 再换句话说，你需要一个非常强劲的燃料来源。

sentences.en: You need that extreme motivation to get started, but that's not what creates sustainable change.
sentences.zh: 你需要那种极端的动力才能起步，但这不是创造可持续改变的原因。

sentences.en: You need to use that launch fuel to, of course, get started, get over the hump of getting started, but then create the habits routine system so it just becomes who you are.
sentences.zh: 你需要用那股启动燃料，当然，先起步，跨过起步那道坎，然后建立习惯、流程、系统，让它变成你的一部分。

sentences.en: And then it doesn't take that motivation or that super potent fuel to maintain those results or reach success.
sentences.zh: 然后你就不再需要那种动力或超级强劲的燃料来维持成果或达到成功了。

sentences.en: So it's counterintuitive as most of life's truths are.
sentences.zh: 这很反直觉，就像人生中大多数真相一样。

sentences.en: But if you want sustainable change in your life, you have to brute force your way into it.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想在生活中实现可持续的改变，你必须用蛮力闯进去。

sentences.en: And that's only stage one. The launch fuel, the motivation, the pain, a win, a loss, or just a burst of willpower.
sentences.zh: 那只是第一阶段。启动燃料、动力、痛苦、一次胜利、一次失败，或者只是一股意志力的爆发。

sentences.en: Something that launches you into an intense period of change.
sentences.zh: 某个把你推入一段剧烈改变期的东西。

sentences.en: And this can be anything. I think the classic example is when a dude goes through a breakup and then decides to start going to the gym, and then he becomes the jacked gym bro.
sentences.zh: 这可以是任何事。我觉得最经典的例子就是，一个男的经历了分手，然后决定开始去健身房，最后变成了肌肉猛男。

sentences.en: Or how a college student gets fed up with being broke and just does everything in his power to make his side hustle or his side business a success.
sentences.zh: 或者一个大学生受够了穷日子，于是用尽一切办法让自己的副业或小生意成功。

sentences.en: I have experienced both of those things.
sentences.zh: 这两件事我都经历过。

sentences.en: That's kind of why I love going to the gym and I love health and fitness today.
sentences.zh: 这大概就是为什么我今天热爱健身、热爱健康和体能。

sentences.en: And it's why I have my businesses today.
sentences.zh: 也是为什么我今天拥有自己的事业。

sentences.en: That's not the fuel that I run on right now, but it's what got me started and it worked.
sentences.zh: 我现在靠的不是那种燃料，但它是让我起步的东西，而且它奏效了。

sentences.en: There's also been many times in my life where I use something that I like to call tactical stress.
sentences.zh: 我人生中还有很多次，我用了某种我喜欢称之为"战术压力"的东西。

sentences.en: As an example, I move into an apartment I can't afford, so I'm forced to make my business successful enough to afford it.
sentences.zh: 举个例子，我搬进一个我负担不起的公寓，所以我被迫把生意做得足够成功来支付它。

sentences.en: Or I go homeless as one example. I wouldn't go homeless, of course, but I believed I would have and that provided me with the fuel to actually make it work.
sentences.zh: 或者像有一次，我无家可归。当然，我不会真的让自己无家可归，但我相信自己会，而这给了我真正把事情做成的燃料。

sentences.en: And I've done this multiple times. And I personally think it's the single greatest business growth hack that there is or financial growth hack.
sentences.zh: 我这么做过很多次。我个人认为这是最厉害的一个业务增长黑客，或者说财务增长黑客。

sentences.en: And of course, that sounds extreme because it is. It's not for everyone, but those who believe in themselves are nodding as they're watching this video.
sentences.zh: 当然，这听起来很极端，因为它就是很极端。这不适合所有人，但那些相信自己的人，看这个视频时正在点头。

sentences.en: Another example is that about five years ago, I would go to music festivals and I would drink and I would party and I would stay out late.
sentences.zh: 另一个例子是，大约五年前，我会去音乐节，喝酒、派对、在外面待到很晚。

sentences.en: And I would do this every two months or so, because that's how far the music festivals were spaced out.
sentences.zh: 我大概每两个月左右就会这么做一次，因为音乐节的间隔差不多就是那么久。

sentences.en: And I would treat it as a form of a glitch in my over-optimized lifestyle because I was the very I was the productivity dude.
sentences.zh: 我会把它当作我过度优化生活方式中的一种小故障，因为我就是那种效率狂人。

sentences.en: I went to bed at a specific time. I woke up at a specific time. I ate a very strict diet again.
sentences.zh: 我在特定时间睡觉，在特定时间起床，吃非常严格的饮食。

sentences.en: I said health and fitness is one of my values, even though this contradicts it.
sentences.zh: 我说过，健康和体能是我的价值观之一，尽管这件事和它矛盾。

sentences.en: But I did enjoy that throwing that little bit of chaos into my optimized routine.
sentences.zh: 但我确实享受往我优化过的日常里扔进那么一点混乱。

sentences.en: And it acted as a nice little shock to the system because I would wake up the next morning and I would feel absolutely terrible, obviously.
sentences.zh: 这对系统来说是一个不错的小冲击，因为第二天早上醒来，我显然会感觉糟透了。

sentences.en: But what would happen is I would feel my business and my health progress slipping.
sentences.zh: 但接下来发生的是，我会感觉到我的生意和健康进展在滑落。

sentences.en: And those goals are values of mine.
sentences.zh: 而那些目标是我的价值观。

sentences.en: They're really important to me.
sentences.zh: 它们对我真的很重要。

sentences.en: They are a part of my identity.
sentences.zh: 它们是我身份的一部分。

sentences.en: And so it felt like a part of me was dying.
sentences.zh: 所以感觉就像我的一部分在死去。

sentences.en: And then I would have this really potent fuel source for the next month, two months to just keep going.
sentences.zh: 然后我就会在接下来的一个月、两个月里，拥有一个非常强劲的燃料来源，让我继续前进。

sentences.en: And that's just what allowed me to continue to hit new highs in business.
sentences.zh: 这就是让我在生意上不断创出新高的原因。

sentences.en: And so that leads to the second most potent fuel source that I found, which is quickly developing a strong disgust for the life that I do not want to live.
sentences.zh: 这就引出了我发现的第二种最强燃料：迅速对自己不想过的生活产生强烈的厌恶。

sentences.en: It's like an anti-vision, something that I can hold in my mind and compare my current actions to.
sentences.zh: 它就像一个反愿景，是我可以放在脑子里、用来对照当前行为的东西。

sentences.en: And I feel like that's something that almost everyone can take advantage of or use as their initial form of launch fuel.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这几乎是每个人都能利用、或者作为初始启动燃料的东西。

sentences.en: And usually you have to be pretty close to rock bottom in order to make this realization because you reach this point where you're like, man, I've been stuck in this position for so long.
sentences.zh: 通常你得离谷底非常近，才能产生这种觉悟，因为你会到达一个点，心想：天啊，我困在这个位置太久了。

sentences.en: I don't like this part of my life, this part of my life, this part of my life.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢我生活的这一部分、这一部分、还有这一部分。

sentences.en: And some people would tell you to just accept it and retreat into your mind and learn how to reframe or change your perspective to view it in a more positive light.
sentences.zh: 有些人会告诉你，接受它就好了，退回你的内心，学会重新框定或改变视角，用更积极的方式去看待它。

sentences.en: And that's a great skill to develop.
sentences.zh: 那是一项很值得培养的技能。

sentences.en: But it also does not change the reality of your life.
sentences.zh: 但它也改变不了你生活的现实。

sentences.en: You can have both.
sentences.zh: 你可以两者都要。

sentences.en: And I would argue that both are better.
sentences.zh: 而且我会说，两者兼备更好。

sentences.en: It's the way of water and the way of fire.
sentences.zh: 这是水之道与火之道。

sentences.en: It's becoming a spiritual warrior, so to say.
sentences.zh: 可以说是成为一个精神战士。

sentences.en: So for the entirety of this week, what I want you to do is this.
sentences.zh: 所以这一整周，我要你做的是这件事。

sentences.en: I want you to observe society and see where most people end up.
sentences.zh: 我要你去观察社会，看看大多数人最终会变成什么样。

sentences.en: It's really not pretty.
sentences.zh: 真的不太好看。

sentences.en: They usually end up broke, overweight, married to someone they grow to hate, and drowning in financial responsibilities that take advantage of their situation, making it nearly impossible to get out.
sentences.zh: 他们通常最终破产、超重、和一个自己逐渐憎恨的人结婚，并且被利用他们处境的各种财务责任压得喘不过气，几乎不可能脱身。

sentences.en: That is the default end state of the average person's life.
sentences.zh: 这就是普通人生活的默认终局。

sentences.en: So if thinking about that and really contemplating it for a week doesn't create this fire in your belly to actually get up and pursue your goals, then I don't know what will.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果花一周时间思考这个、真正去琢磨它，还不能在你肚子里点起一把火，让你真正起身去追求目标，那我就不知道还有什么能做到了。

sentences.en: You're going to have to find your own source of launch fuel.
sentences.zh: 你得找到你自己的启动燃料来源。

sentences.en: What it could be is my version of tactical stress.
sentences.zh: 它可以是我的那种战术性压力。

sentences.en: You put yourself in a do or die situation.
sentences.zh: 你把自己置于一个不成功便成仁的境地。

sentences.en: You move into the apartment you can't afford, and then you're under this immense amount of financial stress, and you can't do what you've been currently doing for the entirety of your life in order to solve that problem, because it's not providing you with the financial security that you need.
sentences.zh: 你搬进你负担不起的公寓，然后承受着巨大的财务压力，而你一辈子都在做的那些事，根本解决不了这个问题，因为它无法给你提供你需要的财务安全感。

sentences.en: So you need to do something different.
sentences.zh: 所以你需要做点不一样的事。

sentences.en: You need to be creative.
sentences.zh: 你需要有创造力。

sentences.en: You need to solve problems, and you probably won't see those opportunities if you're just operating from your current perspective.
sentences.zh: 你需要解决问题，而如果你只是从当前的视角出发，你很可能看不到那些机会。

sentences.en: So you need this vast change in everything.
sentences.zh: 所以你需要一场彻底的改变。

sentences.en: So now we have the launch fuel.
sentences.zh: 现在我们有了启动燃料。

sentences.en: How do we actually turn it into something sustainable?
sentences.zh: 我们怎么把它变成可持续的东西？

sentences.en: So it's just easy.
sentences.zh: 其实很简单。

sentences.en: This discipline is easy.
sentences.zh: 这种自律是轻松的。

sentences.en: And the idea here is that you aren't disciplined because you aren't the person who doesn't view it as discipline.
sentences.zh: 这里的核心想法是：你不自律，是因为你不是那个不把它看作自律的人。

sentences.en: That sounds confusing.
sentences.zh: 这听起来很绕。

sentences.en: You'll understand it in a second, but I want to start with this quote from Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi.
sentences.zh: 你马上就会明白，但我想从 Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi 的这句话开始。

sentences.en: "At this point in our history, it should be possible for an individual to build a self that is not simply the outcome of biological drives and cultural habits, but a conscious personal creation." In other words, if you do not create your own life using this process, it will be created for you.
sentences.zh: “在我们历史的这个节点，一个人应该有可能构建一个自我，这个自我不仅仅是生物驱力和文化习惯的产物，而是一个有意识的个人创造。”换句话说，如果你不用这个过程去创造自己的人生，它就会被别人为你创造好。

sentences.en: If you don't have a routine, you will be assigned one.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有自己的节奏，别人就会给你安排一个。

sentences.en: If you don't have a goal, you will be assigned one.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有自己的目标，别人就会给你指派一个。

sentences.en: If you don't have a vision, you will be assigned one.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有自己的愿景，别人就会替你设定一个。

sentences.en: So on and so forth.
sentences.zh: 以此类推。

sentences.en: You have to create yourself and your life.
sentences.zh: 你必须创造你自己，创造你的人生。

sentences.en: And now I'm begging you to understand this concept.
sentences.zh: 现在我恳求你理解这个概念。

sentences.en: That discipline is a feature of identity.
sentences.zh: 自律是身份的一个特征。

sentences.en: Discipline is a part of who you are.
sentences.zh: 自律是你之所以是你的一部分。

sentences.en: Because do you think that Elon Musk lies around in bed when he wakes up dreading the day ahead?
sentences.zh: 你觉得 Elon Musk 早上醒来，会躺在床上害怕接下来的一天吗？

sentences.en: Do you think he hits snooze five times dreaming of not having to go to work?
sentences.zh: 你觉得他会按五次贪睡键，做梦都希望不用去上班吗？

sentences.en: Do you think Arnold Schwarzenegger had to trick himself into eating healthy and training twice a day?
sentences.zh: 你觉得 Arnold Schwarzenegger 当年需要骗自己才能吃健康餐、一天训练两次吗？

sentences.en: Do you think that high performers of this caliber consider it hard in your sense of the word to do hard things or do they love it?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这个级别的高手，会觉得做难事很"难"——按你对这个词的理解——还是说，他们热爱做难事？

sentences.en: It's just what they do.
sentences.zh: 那只是他们自然而然会做的事。

sentences.en: It's automatic.
sentences.zh: 是自动的。

sentences.en: Now, personally, if I am laser focused on a goal, that's really what matters here.
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言，如果我像激光一样聚焦在一个目标上，这才是真正重要的。

sentences.en: Like I'm focused on cutting weight while hitting my macro targets and getting my lifts in.
sentences.zh: 比如我现在专注于减重，同时要打满我的宏量营养素目标、完成我的训练。

sentences.en: And that's all that matters to me, which is right now in my life.
sentences.zh: 这就是我现阶段唯一在乎的事。

sentences.en: A cheat meal at McDonald's just doesn't sound appetizing at all.
sentences.zh: 麦当劳的一顿欺骗餐，对我来说毫无吸引力。

sentences.en: It sounds disgusting.
sentences.zh: 它让我觉得恶心。

sentences.en: And if I wasn't laser focused on this goal, if I was laser focused on another one, so my health and fitness goals took a backseat, they're still important to me, but not as important than the idea of McDonald's would kind of shift along with that.
sentences.zh: 如果我没有像激光一样聚焦在这个目标上，而是聚焦在另一个目标上，那我的健康和健身目标就会退居二线——它们对我依然重要，但没那么重要了——而我对麦当劳的观感也会随之改变。

sentences.en: Depending on the situation, if it's been a year since I've had McDonald's and it's a one time thing, then yeah, I would consider it at least.
sentences.zh: 看情况，如果我一年没吃过麦当劳，而且只是一次性的，那行，我至少会考虑一下。

sentences.en: But right now, at this point in my life, when laser focused on a goal, it's just disgusting.
sentences.zh: 但现在，在我人生的这个阶段，当我像激光一样聚焦在一个目标上时，它就是恶心的。

sentences.en: It's not even an option.
sentences.zh: 它根本不在选项之内。

sentences.en: You would have to pry me from my chair, throw me in the car, tie me up, and drive me to a remote location in order to get me to sniff a double quarter pounder with cheese.
sentences.zh: 你得把我从椅子上拽起来，扔进车里，绑住我，开到荒郊野外，才能让我闻一口双层吉士汉堡。

sentences.en: In other words, it would take an immense amount of discipline for me to eat mediocre food.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，让我去吃这种平庸的食物，需要极其巨大的自律。

sentences.en: And that sounds pretentious.
sentences.zh: 这话听起来很装。

sentences.en: I'm aware of that.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I'm aware of how it sounds, but it's going to be far easier for me to drop 10 to 20 to 30 pounds.
sentences.zh: 我知道这听起来像什么，但对我来说，减掉 10 磅、20 磅、30 磅，要容易得多。

sentences.en: I don't need to drop 30 pounds, 10 to 20 pounds than it is for the person who just can't stop thinking of the next time that they get to drowning Greece.
sentences.zh: 我不需要减 30 磅，10 到 20 磅就够了——比那些整天只想着下一次什么时候能大吃一顿的人，要容易得多。

sentences.en: They're on their diet, but that's not who they are.
sentences.zh: 他们也在节食，但那不是他们真正是谁。

sentences.en: That's not who they even want to be because their mind isn't aligned with that.
sentences.zh: 那甚至不是他们真正想成为的人，因为他们的心智没有和那个目标对齐。

sentences.en: They can't wait until they can go back to their old self and eventually they snap and they can't stick to the goal.
sentences.zh: 他们等不及要回到原来的自己，最终情绪崩溃，无法坚持目标。

sentences.en: And some people just can't fathom this.
sentences.zh: 有些人就是理解不了这个。

sentences.en: It just doesn't click for them.
sentences.zh: 就是转不过弯来。

sentences.en: And so what they'll say to you is, oh, you just need to lighten up.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会对你说，哦，你只是需要放松一点。

sentences.en: You need to have fun.
sentences.zh: 你需要找点乐子。

sentences.en: You need to live a little bit as a defense mechanism for protecting their identity because what you're doing is exposing their lack of values for something good and positive in their life.
sentences.zh: 你需要稍微享受一下生活——这是一种保护他们自我认同的防御机制，因为你正在做的事情，暴露了他们生命中缺乏对美好和积极事物的追求。

sentences.en: But what they do not understand is that I am having more fun than I would be if I were going with you to spend my entire daily caloric allowance in 15 minutes just to go into a food coma and lay around for the rest of the day.
sentences.zh: 但他们不明白的是，我现在的乐趣，远比跟你一起在15分钟内花光一整天的热量配额、然后陷入食物昏迷、瘫倒一整天要多得多。

sentences.en: That doesn't sound fun.
sentences.zh: 那听起来一点都不好玩。

sentences.en: The same thing goes for when I'm super focused on business.
sentences.zh: 同样的情况也发生在我极度专注于事业的时候。

sentences.en: Yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: I'm at my desk for way too long and my health is dwindling at that point.
sentences.zh: 我在桌前坐得太久，健康在那个阶段确实在走下坡路。

sentences.en: But your version of fun is not my version of fun at that point in time because it is one of the greatest feelings in the world to be in pursuit of your potential with little to no gap between who you are and who you want to be.
sentences.zh: 但在那个时间点上，你的快乐版本不是我的快乐版本，因为世界上最美妙的感觉之一，就是追逐自己的潜能，让"你是谁"和"你想成为谁"之间的差距几乎消失。

sentences.en: You live in the flow state of video game taking on a string of challenging quests you choose to accept and being rewarded amply for doing so maybe not in the form of money but insight experience and direct feedback from reality.
sentences.zh: 你活在心流状态里，就像在玩一个接一个挑战任务的电子游戏，你选择接受这些任务，并因此获得丰厚回报——也许不是金钱，而是洞察、经验和来自现实的直接反馈。

sentences.en: But the thing is, is that identity change is just so abstract.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，身份认同的改变实在太抽象了。

sentences.en: You can't see your identity.
sentences.zh: 你看不见你的身份。

sentences.en: It's not like business where you know exactly what you're doing wrong because you have reality as feedback.
sentences.zh: 它不像做事业，你能确切知道自己哪里做错了，因为现实会给你反馈。

sentences.en: In other words, if you aren't making money or you aren't increasing revenue or you aren't moving toward your business goals then you're doing something wrong and you need to experiment and you need to try new things until you move the needle and then you do more of that thing.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，如果你没赚到钱，或者没有增加收入，或者没有朝着事业目标前进，那你就是在做错事，你需要实验，需要尝试新东西，直到推动进展，然后你就多做那件事。

sentences.en: If you aren't making any money from your business then reality is telling you that you're doing something wrong.
sentences.zh: 如果你的事业一分钱都没赚到，现实就是在告诉你，你做错了什么。

sentences.en: And if you are making money a certain amount of money then reality is telling you that you're exactly where you should be based on the actions that you're doing.
sentences.zh: 如果你赚到了某个数额的钱，现实就是在告诉你，基于你正在做的行动，你正处在你应该在的位置。

sentences.en: How do we take the dirty launch fuel and turn it into a sustainable system that eventually just becomes who I am.
sentences.zh: 我们如何把那种"脏启动燃料"转化为一个可持续的系统，最终让它成为我的一部分？

sentences.en: So I want you to give me a few minutes and I'll show you how to become someone entirely new and a James Clear quote comes to mind for this.
sentences.zh: 所以我想请你给我几分钟，我会向你展示如何成为一个全新的人——这让我想起 James Clear 的一句话。

sentences.en: You should be far more concerned with your current trajectory than with your current results.
sentences.zh: 你应该远比你当前的结果更关心你当前的轨迹。

sentences.en: Now you are the statistical sum of what you repeatedly do and what you do is more than the physical decisions you make.
sentences.zh: 你是你反复所做之事的总和，而你做的事，不只是你做出的物理决策。

sentences.en: You or your self image or your identity is the accumulated result of everything that flows through you in both directions.
sentences.zh: 你——或者说你的自我形象、你的身份认同——是一切流经你的东西在双向累积的结果。

sentences.en: Input and output.
sentences.zh: 输入和输出。

sentences.en: Input equals everything you're exposed to.
sentences.zh: 输入等于你接触到的一切。

sentences.en: Every book you read every post you glance at for a split second.
sentences.zh: 你读的每一本书，你瞟过一眼的每一篇帖子。

sentences.en: Every person you call a friend.
sentences.zh: 你称之为朋友的每一个人。

sentences.en: Every belief your parents and teachers installed before you even had a chance to consent.
sentences.zh: 你的父母和老师在你甚至还没来得及同意之前，就植入你脑中的每一个信念。

sentences.en: The news you read to stay informed.
sentences.zh: 你为了保持信息灵通而读的新闻。

sentences.en: The conversations you overhear.
sentences.zh: 你无意中听到的对话。

sentences.en: The people's whose lives you watch from a distance.
sentences.zh: 你远远观望的那些人的生活。

sentences.en: And output equals everything you produce in the world.
sentences.zh: 而输出等于你在这个世界上产出的一切。

sentences.en: Your decisions actions and work.
sentences.zh: 你的决定、行动和作品。

sentences.en: It's what you do when no one is watching and what you do when everyone is.
sentences.zh: 是没人在看时你做的事，也是所有人都在看时你做的事。

sentences.en: So that is literally the entire equation.
sentences.zh: 所以这基本上就是整个公式。

sentences.en: Input shapes the mind that perceive situations and makes decisions.
sentences.zh: 输入塑造了感知情境和做出决策的心智。

sentences.en: Output shapes the life that presents the next input.
sentences.zh: 输出塑造生活，而生活又呈现下一个输入。

sentences.en: It compounds to feedback loop.
sentences.zh: 这会复合成一个反馈循环。

sentences.en: So to change who we are we have to change this flow of information.
sentences.zh: 所以要改变我们是谁，就必须改变这个信息流。

sentences.en: Now for changing your input the rule is very simple.
sentences.zh: 改变你的输入，规则非常简单。

sentences.en: Curate and protect everything your mind is exposed to on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 精心筛选并保护你大脑每天接触的一切。

sentences.en: You must immerse yourself in stimuli that matches the person you want to become and starves the person you used to be.
sentences.zh: 你必须把自己浸泡在与你想成为的人相匹配的刺激里，同时饿死那个过去的你。

sentences.en: The old you must die.
sentences.zh: 旧的你必须死去。

sentences.en: Now for the remainder of this video some of you may watch it and just think oh that's basic or oh I already knew that.
sentences.zh: 接下来这段视频，有些人可能看了只会觉得"哦，这很基础"或者"哦，我早就知道了"。

sentences.en: But if you actually knew it you wouldn't be in this situation would you?
sentences.zh: 但如果你真的知道，你就不会陷入现在这个处境了，对吧？

sentences.en: Writing it off as basic is preventing you from seeing how simple all of this is.
sentences.zh: 把它贬为"基础"，恰恰阻止了你看到这一切有多简单。

sentences.en: You are not special and you do not need to do what everyone else does in trying to find some new tactic or new method or novel ways of doing things to change your life.
sentences.zh: 你并不特殊，你不需要像其他人一样，试图找什么新战术、新方法或新奇的方式去改变人生。

sentences.en: You just need to change it.
sentences.zh: 你只需要去改变它。

sentences.en: You need to do what's been proven to work for the entirety of human existence.
sentences.zh: 你需要去做那些在人类整个存在历史中已被证明有效的事。

sentences.en: So first you choose your information diet because most people are intellectually obese.
sentences.zh: 所以首先，选择你的信息食谱，因为大多数人都患有"智力肥胖"。

sentences.en: Unfollow mute and unsubscribe from anything that lowers your standards or wastes your attention.
sentences.zh: 取关、静音、退订任何降低你标准或浪费你注意力的东西。

sentences.en: Follow and read the people and ideas that raise it.
sentences.zh: 关注并阅读那些能提升你标准的人和思想。

sentences.en: Your social timeline is an environment just like any other.
sentences.zh: 你的社交媒体时间线和其他任何环境一样，都是一个环境。

sentences.en: You live in it and it influences you on that idea.
sentences.zh: 你活在其中，它也在影响你。基于这个理念——

sentences.en: You have to understand that our phones are so new.
sentences.zh: 你必须明白，手机这个东西太新了。

sentences.en: It's not something our brains are wired for in the past.
sentences.zh: 我们的大脑在过去并没有为它接好线。

sentences.en: Our physical environment is really all that we had.
sentences.zh: 过去，我们的物理环境几乎就是我们拥有的一切。

sentences.en: And what did we do when there was a threat.
sentences.zh: 当有威胁出现时，我们做了什么？

sentences.en: We built shelter.
sentences.zh: 我们建造庇护所。

sentences.en: We built tools.
sentences.zh: 我们制造工具。

sentences.en: We did the things that protected us from the threat and yet you don't have this.
sentences.zh: 我们做了那些保护自己免受威胁的事，但你却没有这个。

sentences.en: You don't have this house that protects you.
sentences.zh: 你没有这个保护你的房子。

sentences.en: You haven't set up the environment so that it actually contributes to your success.
sentences.zh: 你没有设置好一个真正有助于你成功的环境。

sentences.en: Now what I personally like to do for this is just curate and read information from idea dense sources.
sentences.zh: 我个人喜欢做的是，只从信息密度高的来源筛选和阅读信息。

sentences.en: So I have the people that I like to follow and what I do is I'll save their sub stack articles or books PDFs or even YouTube videos to Eden which is a second brain and a place to capture ideas and import all your highlights.
sentences.zh: 我有我喜欢关注的人，我会把他们的 Substack 文章、书籍 PDF，甚至 YouTube 视频保存到 Eden——一个第二大脑，一个捕捉想法并导入你所有高亮标记的地方。

sentences.en: And there is a reader mode in there.
sentences.zh: 那里面有一个阅读模式。

sentences.en: On my phone on the mobile app I'll open the reader mode and then I can read it from there from my reading list and then I can save my highlights in there.
sentences.zh: 在我手机的移动应用上，我会打开阅读模式，然后从我的阅读列表里阅读，并在里面保存我的高亮标记。

sentences.en: And since I'm a content creator I can then ask the AI chat in Eden to pull highlights and ideas as I'm writing and or give me content ideas and there's also the discover feed which many users have said that they actually scroll on instead of social media now which just shows top performing ideas according to your filters which you can save to swipe file boards or chat with to reverse engineer.
sentences.zh: 因为我是一个内容创作者，我可以在写作时让 Eden 里的 AI 聊天调出高亮和想法，或者给我内容创意。还有一个发现信息流，很多用户说他们现在刷这个而不是社交媒体了，它会根据你的过滤器展示表现最好的想法，你可以保存到素材库面板，或者跟它对话来逆向拆解。

sentences.en: Content creator you understand the immense benefit of that and we just introduced the store feature so you can sell digital products and your own products you sell your own knowledge in Eden.
sentences.zh: 内容创作者，你明白这其中的巨大好处。而且我们刚刚推出了商店功能，你可以销售数字产品和你自己的产品，在 Eden 里销售你自己的知识。

sentences.en: So if you have multiple interests or you plan on ever becoming a creator or you are a creator and you don't want to go into software or e-commerce or other things you want to sell your knowledge then Eden is the place to do so.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你有多重兴趣，或者你打算将来成为创作者，或者你已经是创作者但不想涉足软件、电商或其他领域，只想销售你的知识，那么 Eden 就是做这件事的地方。

sentences.en: There's actually a full video on the Eden channel that goes over the store and how to use it and a few ideas that you can use for your first products.
sentences.zh: Eden 频道上其实有一期完整视频，讲了那个商店怎么用，还给了几个你可以用来做第一批产品的点子。

sentences.en: So try out Eden. Now the second thing to do is to choose the people you surround yourself with because their values fears and assumptions about what's normal impossible leak into you even if you think they don't. This is the most difficult part. You can try to bring your friends along with you but it is extremely difficult to help people who don't want to be helped.
sentences.zh: 所以去试试 Eden。第二件要做的事，是选择你身边的人，因为他们的价值观、恐惧、以及对什么是正常、什么是不可能的那些预设，会渗进你体内，哪怕你觉得不会。这是最难的部分。你可以试着拉朋友一起走，但帮一个不想被帮的人，是极其困难的。

sentences.en: Now the third thing to do is interrogate your mind for beliefs that do not serve you because most of your beliefs about money what you deserve in this life and what's possible to achieve were determined before you could even understand the language you speak.
sentences.zh: 第三件要做的事，是审问你的大脑，找出那些对你没用的信念，因为你关于金钱、关于你这辈子配得上什么、关于什么可能达成的信念，大部分在你还没学会说话之前就已经被决定了。

sentences.en: So if you haven't become aware of these beliefs you don't understand what I'm saying and beliefs don't come to mind that you've already shed then it's likely that they haven't been examined and they haven't been changed.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你还没意识到这些信念，你就不理解我在说什么，而如果脑子里没有浮现出那些你已经剥掉的信念，那它们很可能还没被审视过，还没被改变过。

sentences.en: And as someone said some famous person I'm going to sound stupid for not knowing who said this. Oh it's Carl Jung. I'm pretty sure the examined life is not worth living or is that like Aristotle.
sentences.zh: 有人说过，某个名人，我要是不知道是谁说的会显得很蠢。哦，是卡尔·荣格，我很确定。未经审视的人生不值得过，还是说这是亚里士多德说的。

sentences.en: I don't I don't know. Sorry or actually it's the unexamined life is not worth living. It's probably something completely different. I'm an idiot.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，抱歉。或者说其实是未经审视的人生不值得过。可能完全是另一回事。我是个白痴。

sentences.en: Now the fourth thing to do is exchange passive for active consumption because the difference between reading 10 posts fast and one book slowly is drastic.
sentences.zh: 第四件要做的事，是把被动消费换成主动消费，因为快速刷十篇帖子和慢慢读一本书，差别是巨大的。

sentences.en: I bet you can't even tell me about two of the social posts you read yesterday but a life changing YouTube video podcast book chapter or sub stack article that is created with care by someone who is passionate about what they do is something that sticks with you and influences you for the better.
sentences.zh: 我敢打赌，你连昨天读过的两篇社交帖子都讲不出来，但一期改变人生的 YouTube 视频、播客、书里的某一章、或者一篇 substack 文章，由一个有热情的人用心创作出来的东西，会留在你脑子里，往好的方向影响你。

sentences.en: So that's the input part and that's just a daily practice. That's a constant thing. You can't really plan that.
sentences.zh: 所以这是输入的部分，而且这就是一个日常练习。是一件持续的事。你没法真的去规划它。

sentences.en: Yeah you can create a reading ritual and implement the nice habits and you should.
sentences.zh: 对，你可以创造一个阅读仪式，植入那些好习惯，而且你应该这么做。

sentences.en: But it's really just this constant awareness of what you're putting into your mind that you need to realize when you're not in that state of awareness and bring yourself back into it over and over again until it's just what you do.
sentences.zh: 但它其实就是一种持续的觉察，觉察你在往脑子里塞什么，你需要在不在那种觉察状态的时候意识到这一点，然后一次又一次把自己拉回来，直到它变成你自然而然会做的事。

sentences.en: So now we need to make it so easy to succeed. You look stupid if you fail. Now I forgot to mention something important.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们要让成功变得极其容易，容易到如果你失败了，会显得很蠢。哦，我忘了提一件重要的事。

sentences.en: This is the second stage of change.
sentences.zh: 这是改变的第二阶段。

sentences.en: The first stage is the launch fuel that's getting yourself off the ground. That's like 80 percent of it because frankly without that launch fuel you're probably not going to change your inputs because it's just an ingrained habit.
sentences.zh: 第一阶段是启动燃料，是让你自己离开地面。那大概占了 80%，因为坦白讲，没有那个启动燃料，你大概率不会去改变你的输入，因为它就是一个根深蒂固的习惯。

sentences.en: You're going to pick up your phone and you're going to start scrolling and then you're going to get lost in it because there isn't this just potent little voice in the back of your head telling you to do better.
sentences.zh: 你会拿起手机，你会开始刷，然后你会迷失在里面，因为脑子里没有一个强有力的声音在告诉你，要做得更好。

sentences.en: And so without that you won't be able to break through the atmosphere into orbit and then coast the rest of the way toward your goal.
sentences.zh: 所以没有那个燃料，你就没法冲破大气层进入轨道，然后一路滑行到你的目标。

sentences.en: Let's say the moon. And so once you're in orbit how you coast and what you need to set up before you get into orbit is a sustainable system. Now your outputs or decisions and actions occur as a four part feedback loop.
sentences.zh: 比如说月球。而一旦你进入了轨道，你怎么滑行，以及你在进入轨道之前需要设置好什么，就是一个可持续的系统。你的输出，也就是决策和行动，是以一个四步反馈循环的形式发生的。

sentences.en: It goes environment signal behavior payoff and this is essentially the habit loop from B.F. Skinner's operant conditioning which went on to be popularized by Charles Duhigg in the power of habit and James Clear in atomic habits.
sentences.zh: 它的顺序是环境、信号、行为、回报，这本质上就是 B.F. 斯金纳操作性条件反射里的习惯循环，后来被查尔斯·杜希格在《习惯的力量》和詹姆斯·克利尔在《原子习惯》里普及开来。

sentences.en: Q response reward that's just textbook behavioral psychology and it works. So the first step is making the desired output the path of least resistance and the undesired output incredibly inconvenient.
sentences.zh: 提示、反应、奖励，这就是教科书级的行为心理学，而且它确实有效。所以第一步，是让期望的输出成为阻力最小的路径，让不期望的输出变得极其不便。

sentences.en: The second is creating a trigger or signal that starts the behavior that leads to the desired output preferably on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 第二步，是创造一个触发器或信号，来启动那个导向期望输出的行为，最好是每天一次。

sentences.en: The third is reducing success to a minimum recognizable version of the output. So not a great workout but just stepping into the gym.
sentences.zh: 第三步，是把成功缩减到那个输出的最小可识别版本。不是一次很棒的训练，而仅仅是踏进健身房。

sentences.en: And the fourth is the reward which is something enjoyable delivered right after the behavior every single time until the behavior is the reward itself.
sentences.zh: 第四步是奖励，是行为之后立刻给予的某种令人愉悦的东西，每一次都要有，直到这个行为本身变成奖励。

sentences.en: So that's the feedback loop and now I just want to go over two examples so we can ground it and understand it.
sentences.zh: 这就是反馈循环，现在我只想讲两个例子，好让它落地，好理解它。

sentences.en: And the first of course is just going to the gym. I love going to the gym. It's a great thing to do. I think more people should do it.
sentences.zh: 第一个当然是去健身房。我喜欢去健身房。这是一件很棒的事。我觉得更多人去。

sentences.en: Of course you get to look good. You get to look jacked. But if you build muscle now through resistance training then in your older years when you get older you're not going to be as frail.
sentences.zh: 当然，你会变得好看，你会变得肌肉发达。但如果你现在通过抗阻训练练出肌肉，那么等你老了以后，就不会那么脆弱。

sentences.en: You're not going to need a cane or a walker so early. You're going to be able to be more active. It's just a good thing to do and it's very enjoyable.

sentences.en: And if you don't create that enjoyment or understand that enjoyment then it's just going to be a pain to do for the rest of your life.
sentences.zh: 如果你不创造那种享受，或者不理解那种享受，那它就会变成余生里一件痛苦的事。

sentences.en: So here's what we do for going to the gym. First you curate your inputs. So you follow two to three sources of inspiration and education so your feed or social media reminds you of your goal as you make this change.
sentences.zh: 所以去健身房我们这么做。首先，你要筛选你的信息输入。关注两到三个能给你灵感和知识的来源，这样你的信息流或社交媒体就会在你做出改变时，不断提醒你你的目标。

sentences.en: What I like to do right now as I'm cutting is I just find someone that I resonate with and I just listen to them on YouTube on my walks and they give me little tips and tricks that I can try and it just keeps me in the mindset because I'm taking in that input and it makes me feel like I'm doing it with that person.
sentences.zh: 我现在减脂期喜欢做的是，找一个我认同的人，散步时就在 YouTube 上听他们讲，他们会给我一些可以尝试的小技巧，这能让我保持那种心态，因为我接收了这些输入，感觉就像和那个人一起在做这件事。

sentences.en: And of course I learn new things and in order to do this you kind of have to unfollow or just not watch or listen or read fitness content that sells insecurity and the acceptance of mediocrity then surround yourself with at least one person who already trains because their normal becomes your normal then examine the beliefs installed in you about your body and what you're capable of.
sentences.zh: 当然我也会学到新东西。要做到这一点，你得取关或者干脆别看、别听、别读那些贩卖焦虑和接受平庸的健身内容，然后让自己身边至少有一个已经在训练的人，因为他们的常态会成为你的常态，接着审视那些根植于你内心的、关于你身体和你能力的信念。

sentences.en: Then after that you need to engineer your outputs so your environment you set your clothes out the night before remove all junk food from your cabinets fill it with foods that allow you to hit your clerk intake and macro targets and micronutrients and study the exercises you're doing in tomorrow's workout so you have clarity and maybe a bit of excitement to try them out.
sentences.zh: 之后，你需要设计你的输出，也就是你的环境。前一晚把衣服摆好，清空橱柜里所有垃圾食品，换上能帮你达到热量摄入、宏量营养素和微量营养素目标的食物，研究一下明天训练要做的动作，这样你就有清晰度，甚至可能有点兴奋想去试试。

sentences.en: The next thing is signal so go at the same time to the gym every day for me that time is around 11 a.m. and if you're just starting set an alarm for that time and make the alarm a distinct tone that represents going to the gym.
